title: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd (NSE: AJMERA) — Institutional Equity Research Dossier

technical_spec.stage_explanation: The 2026-11-16 ledger classifies AJMERA as Stage 3 (₹132.47) because its 200-day SMA (₹125.41) remains below its 63-days-ago level (₹148.55), whereas the 2026-11-17 TradingView snapshot (₹135.69, +5.9% above 10W EMA ₹128.10) shows an 11.7% Bollinger squeeze with in_thewrap_stage2: False; our independent verdict is WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (₹123.00–₹130.00, stop ₹117.00) rather than BUY_AT_CMP_NO_FOMO due to overhead supply at ₹143.85–₹155.11.
technical_spec.evaluation_stage_explanation: Reconciling the 2026-11-16 Stage 3 ledger (₹132.47; declining 63d-ago 200DMA ₹148.55 -> ₹125.41) with the 2026-11-17 TradingView 11.7% Bollinger squeeze (₹135.69, +5.9% above 10W EMA ₹128.10) and in_thewrap_stage2: False, we treat this as an early Stage 1B-to-Stage 2 transition and enforce WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (₹123.00–₹130.00, stop ₹117.00) rather than BUY_AT_CMP_NO_FOMO.

holding_rationale: Hold all 1,300 shares (4.01% weight, ₹130.70 cost) with a hard weekly-close stop at ₹117.00. Monitor H2 FY27 pre-sales and the Wadala Boutique Office launch closely. If shares reach ₹155–₹168 while H2 pre-sales trail the ₹1,893 Cr run-rate, trim 400 shares.

holding_alerts.instruction: Exit all 1,300 shares on any weekly close below ₹117.00. That level breaks the 50D SMA (₹123.12) and Pivot S1 (₹117.48), invalidating the base.
New capital may stage staggered entries in ₹123.00–₹130.00. Require H2 FY27 launch and pre-sales confirmation first.
Trim 400 shares to lock gains if price hits ₹168.00 without H2 pre-sales >= ₹1,500 Cr or better CFO/PAT conversion.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Next marginal ₹100,000 of IN equity capital (or proceeds if AJMERA's ₹117.00 hard stop triggers)

destinations.rationale: Preserve dry powder while AJMERA's 86% H2-loaded FY27 pre-sales guidance and Kanjurmarg conversion remain unverified.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy only on confirmed H2 launch velocity or a pullback into ₹123–₹130 support.

destinations.rationale: Active shortlist leader (2026-11-17 TradingView STAGE_2 at ₹4,908.00 vs. 2026-11-16 ledger Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) at ₹4,910.00) with superior capital efficiency vs. AJMERA's 11.5% ROE.
destinations.entry_condition: Enter near TITAN support ₹4,659.56–₹4,824.93 with invalidation stop ₹4,559.80.

destinations.rationale: Higher ROE (14.6%) and lower leverage (0.14x D/E) than AJMERA, but adding it alongside held AJMERA would double MMR real-estate beta.
destinations.entry_condition: Revisit only if AJMERA is exited on stop or trimmed.

primer: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd (NSE: AJMERA) is a Mumbai-anchored residential and commercial developer. Its balance sheet rests on a near-zero-cost 100-acre Wadala i-Land township. At ₹135.69 (15.78x TTM P/E, 1.82x P/B), the stock trades at a 23%–43% earnings discount to MMR peers. The tape is coiling in an 11.7% Bollinger squeeze above its 10-week EMA (₹128.10). Existing 1,300 shares (4.01% weight, ₹130.70 cost) stay held with a ₹117.00 weekly-close stop, while new capital waits for ₹123.00–₹130.00 support and H2 FY27 pre-sales proof.
